events.text: William the Conqueror lands in England, beginning the Norman conquest.
American and French forces begin the siege of Yorktown.
U.S. Army aviators complete the first aerial circumnavigation of the world.
Alexander Fleming notices the mould that leads to his discovery of penicillin.
Paul Henderson's late goal wins the Summit Series for Canada against the Soviet Union.
Ariel Sharon visits the Temple Mount, shortly before the Second Intifada begins.
SpaceX's Falcon 1 becomes the first privately developed liquid-fuel rocket to reach orbit.
